_readme:
[Poker 2026-10-14] New Texas Hold'em config. 'official' = copied from the client (ini/luacfg newtexas.lua NewTexasTableList) or the official server tables in Infinity[DB]
ewtexas_*.txt. 'derived' = not in any client/server data, chosen by us.

cash._levels: official: client NewTexasTableList (silver buy-in range; bet_unit = big blind)
cash._derived: rakePercent, rakeCapBigBlinds, noFlopNoDrop, actionSeconds, nextHandSeconds, maxTablesPerLevel, sitOutHandsBeforeKick, requestCooldownMs are DERIVED
cash._enabledTypes: 0 = Texas Hold'em, 2 = Omaha (no-limit, DERIVED). 1 'crazy' and 3 '3-card' are off: their rules are not in the client.
cash._otherSeatOnlineFlag: 2471 f1 for other players' seats. 1 = client draws the seat only if it already knows the player (cross-server info); 0 = seat drawn with the client's placeholder name. Keep 0 until verified live.
cash._addTime: addTimeMaxPerHand official (client lua GetAddTimeTimes = 2); cost DERIVED (silver = N big blinds)

sng._readme:
Sit & Go. Races/buy-ins/blind seconds/return rate/prizes/starting chips are OFFICIAL from Infinity[DB]
ewtexas_sng_*.txt; maxPlayers 5 / minPlayers 3 official from client lua newtexas_sng. Blind schedule starts at newtexas_sng_stage row 1 for every race (DERIVED: stage_index mapping not recoverable). enabledRaces: 31-36 normal Texas; 37-42 'crazy' and 49-54 unknown variant are off; 43-48 Omaha (variant column 2, medium confidence) off by default.

boyi._readme: BoYi (Poker Level) via 2234. 249 levels official (client BoYiTip.lua). EXP values are DERIVED (not in the client): EXP to next level = expBase + expPerLevel*(level-1); a played hand gives expPerHand, winning a pot adds expPerWin. Saved in Users\<uid>.ini [Poker] BoYi=level|exp.

mtt._readme:
MTT. OFFICIAL from Infinity[DB]
ewtexas_mtt_*.txt: Gold (31, 20,000 entry, daily 09:00-12:00) and Platinum (32, 200,000, 13:00/14:00), 100,000 start chips, 120 s levels, first blind row, min 50 / max 1000 players, 90% return, guarantee 25M / 100M, prize shares (type 4 rows = 1/10000 of the pool, 'up to rank'). DERIVED: SB = BB/2 and no ante, even split of a share between the ranks a row covers, table balancing, a cancelled game is refunded at once (official text says via mail), the 'honorGuarantee' switch, minPlayersOverride (0 = official).
